about: HD surface sets (Improvement Ideas W4, docs/art/textures.md): one Gemini swatch per surface at 2K with art/prompts/surface_preamble.txt and a look target frame as the style reference (ref: art/generated/look_targets/<ref>.png), made seamless by blender/make_surface.py (tools/art/build_surfaces.py), with a normal map and an occlusion-roughness-metal map. variants: how many edge-matched variants the surface has in all; the further ones are quilted from the first tile's own content (organic surfaces only: a quilt would break the lines of boards, tiles and courses). view: floor (top-down), wall (elevation) or roof. material: overrides written to the manifest entry's material. new: a surface the kit adds (no Classic tile). A recipe may give pieces (how many stones or boards across one tile) to cut the tile from as much of the swatch as holds that many, for a swatch Gemini drew at the wrong scale; the spectral count it relies on can mistake mortar lines for pieces, so check its printed count. grade: a colour multiplier on the painted tile. derived: surfaces made from another's set, turned a quarter. crop: the share of the swatch's width one tile takes, for pieces that came out too small. brightness: a fixed gain instead of matching the old tile's average brightness.
prompt_template: Seamless tileable texture of {subject}, {view}, filling the whole square edge to edge, painted in the style of the reference picture's world (ignore its layout and characters).

views.floor: seen straight from above (orthographic top-down, no perspective)
views.wall: seen straight on as a flat elevation (orthographic, no perspective)
views.roof: seen straight onto the roof plane (orthographic, no perspective)
